A task function receives its own protothread and task descriptor. It must follow the PT_BEGIN / PT_END pattern.

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to the task's protothread (same as &task->pt).
Pointer to the task descriptor (for user_data, delay, etc.).

simplesect.para: Protothread status (PT_IDLE, PT_MORE, PT_EXITED, or PT_ENDED).

briefdescription.para: Task descriptor for the cooperative scheduler.

detaileddescription.para: Defines the task control block (SYN_Task) that pairs a protothread with scheduling metadata: priority, state, name, delay target, and optional event-wait fields for true blocking.
Tasks are caller-owned — you allocate them however you like (static array, global, on the stack). The scheduler just takes a pointer to your array.

simplesect.title: Task restart and static local state
simplesect.para: syn_task_restart() resets the protothread continuation (lc), delay deadlines, and event wait masks. It does NOT reset static local variables inside the task function. Place all state initialization after PT_BEGIN() or reset static state inside task-private user_data structs to ensure clean restarts.
